_source: Digital Entrepreneur — Brand Guidelines, 2026 First Edition (brand_guidelines.pdf)
rules: Digital Lime only for CTAs, key highlights and active states — max ~10% of any frame.
No drop shadows; depth from Graphite borders and contrast. Radii: 8 buttons, 12 cards, 999 tags.
Icons: thin-line (Lucide) in white or lime, never emoji or multi-colour (use sticker.icon, not emoji).
Imagery: high contrast, deep blacks, desaturated; B&W preferred over poor colour. No stock clichés or posed smiles.
Text over footage always sits on a 60–80% black gradient scrim.
Voice: direct, precise, no fluff. Specific numbers and outcomes in on-screen copy.
Video mode: lit canvas + grain, soft shadows, paper cards for contrast moments; max 2 graphic elements on screen; prefer real screenshots/recordings over abstract diagrams.

video._why: Owner approved (Oct 2026): on video, relax UI-only rules — lit canvas, soft depth, light cards — keep colours, type, voice, lime discipline.

bright._why: Owner asked (Oct 2026) to move off dark + lime. Outlier reels in the niche are bright and airy with meaning-coded colour: green = right/gain, red = wrong/limit, gold = money. Lime stays as the brand highlighter only.
